description: This Java class 'PolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper' maps responses related to policy modifications within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It extends an abstract mapper class and implements response signal mapping, validating responses, constructing topic paths, and enhancing payloads based on response content.

classes.name: PolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class responsible for mapping policy modify response signals, validating responses, constructing topic paths, and enriching payloads with response data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the command response's class name ends with 'Response', throwing an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a TopicPathBuilder initialized with the entity ID from the command, appending the policies path.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enriches the payload builder with the status code from the response and incorporates the entity's schema version if present.
